name: llm-verifier
description: Decentralized marketplace for verifying AI model outputs with economic accountability

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd contracts && npm install && cd ../api && npm install && cd ../verifier-node && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:api && npm run build:verifier
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:api && npm run test:verifier && npm run test:sdk
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network arbitrum-sepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network arbitrum-one

author: LLM Verifier Team
